case_title: JOE SOHEYLI VS. HAIR CLUB FOR MEN, LLC

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-02-2009 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF SOHEYLI, JOE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HAIR CLUB FOR MEN, LLC $1,595.00 PRINCIPAL, $60.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,655.00, THIS COURT FINDS THAT THE "NEW SERVICES AGREEMENT" INVALID ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE CONTRACT IS AN ADHESION CONTRACT AND THEREFORE UNENFORCEABLE. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS DEFENDANT'S EXHIBITS RECEIVED
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT
REQUEST TO CORRECT OR CANCEL JUDGMENT AND ANSWER FILED BY DEFENDANT HAIR CLUB FOR MEN, LLC
NOTICE OF APPEAL FILED BY APPELLANT HAIR CLUB FOR MEN, LLC MAILED TO RESPONDENT SOHEYLI, JOE
ORDER ON (SC-108) REQUEST TO CORRECT OR CANCEL JUDGMENT. THE REQUEST IS DENIED. APPEAL FILED IS PENDING. APPEAL VACATES ORIGINAL JUDGMENT, AND WILL RESULT IN TRIAL DE NOVO. -COMMISSIONER PAUL SLAVIT-
